ringerVolume.description: Specify a ringer volume level through a numeric value between 0 and 15.

speakerVolume.description: Specify a speaker volume level through a numeric value between 0 and 15.

handsetVolume.description: Specify a handset volume level through a numeric value between 0 and 15.

headsetVolume.description: Specify a headset volume level through a numeric value between 0 and 15.

eHookEnabled.description: Enable/disable the wireless headset hookswitch control.

allowEndUserOverrideEnabled.description: Enable/disable to preserve the existing values on the phone and not the values defined for the device settings.
